title: a swapped stage's unique replacement is deleted on refusal
trigger: after a successful exclusive copy and open, the descriptor's original inode was renamed aside and another writer put `WRONG` at its former staging path *between the fresh stat and the second stat*
measured: `stage: null` rather than its unique `WRONG`; the moved-aside original still read `FIRST`

title: nonempty wrong files and symlinks still turn a failed restore into successful incomplete resume
trigger: invokes the real `createSessionManager(parseArgs(['--resume', id]))` twice, with an archive containing `LAST`. First attempt refuses the conflicting live path. Without any intervening repair, the second opens
measured: the second opens successfully with `X` (short), `NOT THE ARCHIVED BYTES` (long), `NOPE` (same length), a symlink to `WRONG`, or a symlink directly to the archived file
how_found_quote: a symlink to `WRONG`, or a symlink directly to the archived file

title: a genuinely complete session cannot resume after an intentional empty artifact rewrite
trigger: first complete `restoreArchivedSession` returned `notRestored: []`, then a tool output was intentionally rewritten to zero bytes
measured: Both ordinary resume attempts now fail with a restore conflict even though the live transcript and every artifact were already present
how_found_quote: new `empty-archive` and `empty-archive-existing-empty` controls each opened twice

title: equal size and timestamps do not prove that the bytes read are the bytes published
trigger: Its artifact stage was rewritten in place from `FIRST` to same-length `WRONG` after the real descriptor read but before the real second stat
measured: Both recorded stats are identical (`size: 5`, `mtimeMs: 1793358064000`, `ctimeMs: 1793358064000`, same `dev`/`ino`). Production archive returned `archived: 1, errors: []`, canonical `WRONG`, live `FIRST`
how_found_quote: The real Minix filesystem mounted privately for [coarse-minix-artifact-r19.log](coarse-minix-artifact-r19.log) reports `fsType: 19802`, supports hardlinks, and records one-second timestamps

title: a FIFO in a required artifact path blocks ordinary resume
trigger: uses a real FIFO with no writer and a separate Bun child
measured: The child printed `R19_FIFO_ATTEMPT` and never printed a return or refusal; the exact child was stopped by a four-second external timeout (`exit 124`)
how_found_quote: uses a real FIFO with no writer and a separate Bun child

title: the claimed all-instruction recovery cutover is incomplete
trigger: A stage emptied at its active stat boundary reports `run \`omp gc --archive\` again`
measured: argv `['gc','--archive']`, exit 0, `GC dry-run (.../WRONG DEFAULT)`, `sessions: 0/0 archived`; it did not retry with `--apply` or the right agent directory
how_found_quote: runs that exact printed command through a real Bash parser for an agent directory containing both a space and a single quote

title: published contract still contradicts current behavior and these probes
trigger: claims every recovery instruction is correctly scoped and the three-stat proof establishes staged bytes; findings 4 and 6 contradict both
measured: still says `--archive` needs `--forward-only` and a restore removes the archived copy in its old lifecycle table, while its appended round-nineteen section says the opposite

title: untouched native joining-child loss: a child joining after enumeration loses its flushed turn to reclaim
trigger: a real native child can join after the parent session's ownership tree was enumerated, hold its own lease, flush `UNIQUE R13 NATIVE TURN`
measured: then lose that turn while reclaim returns `reclaimed: 1, errors: []`. A subsequent successful restore lacks it
how_found_quote: proves a real native child can join after the parent session's ownership tree was enumerated
